fields.description: Fetched from the Purchase Receipt - this is exactly which batch this row's price applies to, so approval can push it onto the right Batch record.
fields.label: Batch No

fields.description: Tablets/units per strip or pack - fetched from the Purchase Receipt.
fields.label: Packing

fields.description: Number of strips/packs received - fetched from the Purchase Receipt.
fields.label: No of Unit

fields.description: Strips/packs the supplier gave free - reduces the billable Qty, not the qty received into stock.
fields.label: Free

fields.description: Packing x No of Unit - total tablets/units received.
fields.label: Qty

fields.description: Rate per single tablet/unit, as billed on the supplier invoice - not per strip.
fields.label: P Rate

fields.description: Qty x P Rate, minus any free tablets/units - the taxable value before GST.
fields.label: Amount

fields.description: Flat rupee amount off this row, entered by the store person. Doesn't reduce GST - GST is calculated on the full Amount, same as the supplier invoice.
fields.label: Discount

fields.description: Half of GST %.
fields.label: CGST Rate

fields.description: Half of GST Amount.
fields.label: CGST Amount

fields.description: Half of GST %.
fields.label: SGST Rate

fields.description: Half of GST Amount.
fields.label: SGST Amount

fields.description: Kept for inter-state purchases - not wired up yet, add later when needed.
fields.label: IGST Rate

fields.description: Kept for inter-state purchases - not wired up yet, add later when needed.
fields.label: IGST Amount

fields.description: P Rate x (1 + GST% / 100), net of Discount - the true landed cost per tablet/unit, including tax.
fields.label: Purchase Cost (incl. GST)

fields.description: What this item was billed at last time - fetched from the Item, for comparison only.
fields.label: P.Cost (Last Purchase Cost)

fields.description: Amount + CGST Amount + SGST Amount + IGST Amount - this row's total before the bill-level Discount is applied.
fields.label: Total Amount

fields.description: Manufacturer's Max Retail Price, per tablet/unit.
fields.label: MRP

fields.description: MRP x Packing - for cross-checking against the price printed on the strip/box.
fields.label: Packing MRP

fields.description: The base selling price used for billing, before Selling GST - equal to MRP.
fields.label: Single Tablet Price

fields.description: Always equal to GST % above - entered once, applies to both purchase and selling tax.
fields.label: Selling GST %

fields.description: Half of Selling GST Amount.
fields.label: Selling CGST Amount

fields.description: Half of Selling GST Amount.
fields.label: Selling SGST Amount

fields.description: Single Tablet Price + Selling GST Amount - what the hospital charges the patient per tablet/unit.
fields.label: Final Selling Price
